title: Structured Job Posting Extraction
task_spec: Write a prompt that reads an unstructured job posting and extracts: title, company, location, salary_range (or null), requirements (string array). Return valid JSON matching that schema exactly.
reference_solution_prompt:
Extract structured information from the following job posting and return it as a JSON object with exactly these fields:
- title (string): the job title
- company (string): the company name
- location (string): the job location
- salary_range (string or null): the salary range if mentioned, otherwise null
- requirements (array of strings): list of job requirements

Return only valid JSON with no explanation, markdown formatting, or code blocks.
